Assessments are carried out primarily remotely, via video calling. It can be done from anywhere in the UK as long as you have a computer, webcam and strong internet connection. The assessments include a project with questioning and a professional discussion based on a portfolio of evidence.

This is a flexible position that you can work from home, choosing your own hours (within office hours).

The IQA role involves:

  • Reviewing assessors’ justifications for assessment
  • Confirming final grading
  • Providing feedback on assessment quality, processes and procedures

The assessor role involves:

  • Marking submitted evidence using a defined assessment plan and grading criteria
  • Making sound judgements about the standard of the apprentice’s knowledge and competence
  • Providing robust feedback to the apprentice and arriving at an overall grade
  • Attending standardisation meetings twice annually
  • Working as part of the 1st for Awarding assessment team
  • Maintaining your own professional development.

The ideal candidate will have the following:

Essential

  • Recent, relevant experience in the marketing profession – working at or above the level of the apprenticeship you’ll be assessing (within the last 3 years, or with substantial, proven experience if earlier).

  • Strong understanding of marketing practice, with the credibility to assess apprentices fairly and consistently.
  • Highly organised 
  • Reliable and trustworthy 
  • Able to plan your own schedule and commit to agreed times/bookings 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Desirable

  • Experience working as an Independent Assessor, coach or tutor 
  • Grading experience 
  • A good understanding of apprenticeship standards
  • Prevent and safeguarding training

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers

  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

Power Your Future with Qualus in our Design Engineering department as a Relay Settings Engineer. Are you interested in growing your career doing relay settings? Apply today!

Responsibilities

  • Present technical solutions to key customers respond in real time to technical concerns and answer questions in a knowledgeable, articulate manner.
  • Work collaboratively with the appropriate groups/ individuals in Qualus to develop and implement technical solutions that support the objectives of the Engineering Department.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with a power systems focus. An MS Degree in engineering will be considered in lieu of the BS Engineering degree. International Engineering Degrees will be considered.
  • Experience in protection and control engineering and relay settings.
  • Experience using ASPEN or CAPE
  • Professional Engineering registration or plan to become registered is a plus.
  • Must have strong analytical and computer skills.
  • Must be able to identify necessary software to complete needed design work.
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills.
  • Possess ability to effectively communicate with a wide variety of support personnel.
  • Strong commitment to customer service and care. Highly motivated "self‐starter"
  • Proven multitasking skills. Excellent document management and organizational skills.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. ABOUT US

At VibeIQ, our mission is to become the market-leading, global solution for companies that create physical products. We’re building the platform where the art and science of product creation intersect—providing teams with a shared workspace to collaborate, iterate and make smarter, data-driven decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Our work helps companies bring better products to market faster, with greater clarity and confidence.

POSITION SUMMARY

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of business with our enterprise retail clients. You'll be the primary post-sale relationship owner, responsible for onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth across a portfolio of high-ACV accounts. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that’s critical to help our customers adopt our software. You’ll wear many hats: part project manager, part trusted advisor, part product advocate.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Account Ownership & Relationship Management
    1. Own a portfolio of enterprise retail customers, serving as their trusted advisor
    2. Build and maintain strong executive and operational relationships
    3. Conduct regular check-ins, QBRs, and strategic planning sessions
  2. Onboarding, Implementation & Configuration
    1. Project manage configuration updates for customers post go-live
    2. Deliver tailored training tips and tricks based on custom setups
    3. Track time and milestones for invoicing and internal reporting
  3. Ongoing Support & Escalation Management
    1. Serve as the point of contact for escalations and issue resolution
    2. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to communicate customer needs and close feedback loops
    3. Maintain up-to-date documentation on customer environments
  4. Value Delivery & Retention
    1. Own the renewal process and flag expansion opportunities to Sales
    2. Monitor and improve customer health scores


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  1. 3–5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation roles (SaaS preferred)
  2. Background in retail, wholesale, or fashion/apparel technology
  3. Experience managing high-ACV customers ($50K+ ARR)
  4. Strong project management skills (timelines, stakeholders, risks)
  5. Excellent communication, collaboration, and customer empathy
  6. Highly organized; able to track time and manage multiple concurrent accounts


BONUS POINTS

  1. Experience at a fast-paced startup or high-growth SaaS company
  2. Exposure to product configuration or technical onboarding
  3. Comfortable using tools like Hubspot, Jira, or Zendesk
  4. Prior experience with time-tracked billing or scoped services

BENEFITS

401(k), Health, Dental, Vision

12 Paid Holidays per Year

Discretionary Time Off

Paid Parental Leave

raw.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Enterprise Sales VP, you'll be embedded in the Enterprise Sales team and report directly to the VP, Public and Labor.

The Enterprise Sales VP, Public Sector will expand our footprint with large public-sector clients through direct sales. This is an individual contributor seat with a defined national territory: a named book of public-sector entities at 10,000 to 100,000 lives, including school districts, cities, counties, universities, and public benefit pools. We are expanding our team in order to continue to hit our ambitious Enterprise Sales goals. We are searching for a candidate who possesses the exceptional ability to establish and cultivate high-level relationships, as this will be instrumental in our pursuit of growth and innovation.

What you will do

  • Own the direct sales cycles and deploy sales objectives through the preparation and measuring of sales quotas, prospecting and pipeline management across a named national book of public-sector entities
  • Run RFP-driven pursuits end to end: procurement compliance, consultant management, finalist presentations, and board and committee approvals, across 9 to 18 month, multi-stakeholder cycles
  • Keep current with market knowledge and competitor products to effectively communicate the value proposition of a relationship with Garner
  • Support the development of new, strategic relationships with public-sector benefits consultants and benefits directors, and influence the buying decision

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of deep sales experience with a focus on health benefits (medical, ancillary, vendor) via brokers, consultants, and insurers
  • 5+ years selling into public-sector entities strongly preferred, with deep fluency in public procurement mechanics: RFP cycles, evaluation scoring, protest risk, sunshine laws, and board dynamics
  • Existing relationships within the public-sector consultant ecosystem (including the public practices at Segal, Aon, WTW, Mercer, and Gallagher) and with public-sector benefits directors
  • Minimum of 3+ years experience selling large Enterprise clients
  • A data literacy with the ability to turn complex, disparate datasets into insights that drive actions
  • Proven experience with developing processes (sales playbooks, KPIs, collateral creation, etc), and executing on sales strategies to promote long term success
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team's metrics.

What you'll get here

You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you'll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It's demanding by design. You'll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Where you will work:

Garner is headquartered in NYC, but this position is available for individuals who are comfortable with remote work and occasional travel to HQ.

Visa sponsorship:Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation

The target total comp (inclusive of base + bonus) range for this role is $425,000 - $475,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that's what you're looking for, we'd love to meet you.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the financial futures of retirement plan participants while serving as a strategic communications leader for our Mid/Large Segment clients. The successful candidate will gain valuable experience influencing client strategy, leading complex initiatives, and delivering measurable results at scale.

  • Develop and execute communication strategies, campaigns, and programs that improve participant behaviors related to savings, investing, retirement readiness, financial wellness, and longevity preparedness.

  • Provide guidance and support to peers by sharing knowledge and expertise.

  • Experience presenting communication recommendations and campaign results to clients and stakeholders.

POSITION SUMMARY

THE COST ESTIMATOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DEVELOPING ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES AND FINANCIAL MODELS THAT SUPPORT BID AND PROPOSAL ACTIVITIES ACROSS FRANKLIN ENERGY. WORKING CLOSELY WITH THE PRINCIPAL COST ESTIMATOR AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL TEAMS INCLUDING BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, CLIENT DELIVERY, FINANCE, ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SOLUTIONS, AND STRATEGY, THIS ROLE DEVELOPS PRICING MODELS, ANALYZES COST INPUTS, AND SUPPORTS COMPETITIVE PRICING STRATEGIES FOR NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES.

THE COST ESTIMATOR PLAYS A KEY ROLE IN ENSURING PROPOSALS ARE FINANCIALLY SOUND, DATA-DRIVEN, AND ALIGNED WITH ORGANIZATIONAL GOALS. THIS POSITION REQUIRES STRONG ANALYTICAL SKILLS, ATTENTION TO DETAIL, AND THE ABILITY TO COLLABORATE WITH MULTIPLE STAKEHOLDERS TO GATHER INPUTS, EVALUATE ASSUMPTIONS, AND DELIVER CLEAR AND ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES WITHIN TIGHT PROPOSAL TIMELINES.

THIS ROLE ALSO CONTRIBUTES TO MAINTAINING ESTIMATING TOOLS, ANALYZING HISTORICAL PROPOSAL DATA, AND IDENTIFYING OPPORTUNITIES TO IMPROVE PRICING ACCURACY AND ESTIMATING EFFICIENCY.

raw.description:
About Centerbase
At Centerbase, we empower mid-size law firms to run their practices more efficiently, profitably, and client-centrically. Our cloud-based legal practice management platform streamlines the entire client lifecycle from intake to billing to business intelligence, helping attorneys deliver exceptional service while achieving their growth goals.
We’re more than just a software provider—we’re a partner in transformation. With a focus on automation, flexibility, and continuous innovation, we give firms the tools to modernize operations, improve collaboration, and adapt to the evolving expectations of today’s clients and legal professionals. At Centerbase, we come to work every day committed to making legal work easier, smarter, and more impactful for the firms and communities we serve.
Everything we do is guided by four core values:
  • Customer Centric
  • Stronger Together
  • Be the Difference
  • Relentless Improvement
These values shape who we are: a dedicated, inventive, and passionate team committed to empowering law firms to achieve lasting growth and success.

Summary

Centerbase is seeking a hands-on Director, Cloud & IT Operations to lead the operational backbone of our cloud-driven business through an active migration and beyond. Reporting to the CTO, you'll own the day-to-day across our cloud environment — as we consolidate onto AWS from a mix of Azure and colocation — plus our internal IT and corporate systems and the execution of our security and compliance programs, keeping Centerbase secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient as we grow.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll land the cloud migration and stand up modern operations — DevOps, observability, incident response, and cost discipline — while leading a lean team of employees and specialized service partners. You'll bring an AI-forward mindset to force-multiply a small team, and you'll know when to build in-house versus leverage providers.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Operations — Land the Migration & Own It · the priority

  • Land the in-flight consolidation onto AWS (from Azure and colocation), then run best-practice cloud operations: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and release/change management.
  • Build observability and performance monitoring — metrics, logging, tracing, and SLOs/SLIs — and drive down alert noise and mean-time-to-resolution.
  • Own the production incident and issue-resolution process: severity levels, on-call, runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  • Ensure reliability and resilience — high availability, backup, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), and regular DR testing.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps on operational readiness and the platform-vs-product infrastructure boundary.
  • Bring an AI-forward approach to operations — use automation and AI to force-multiply a lean team across monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and cost analysis.

Cloud Cost Management (FinOps)

  • Own a growing cloud spend: cost visibility and tagging, rightsizing, commitments (Savings Plans / Reserved Instances), budgets, and anomaly detection — keeping the migration cost-disciplined.
  • Drive continuous cost optimization and cost accountability across teams.
  • Rationalize the SaaS and tooling portfolio (including AI tools) — consolidate overlapping tools and renegotiate vendors.

Internal IT & Corporate Technology

  • Own the internal IT ecosystem — networks, endpoints, productivity tools, and identity management.
  • Run onboarding/offboarding, role-based access controls, and device lifecycle management.
  • Manage third-party SaaS systems and integrations; drive automation and a strong employee-IT experience.
  • Oversee help desk operations with a customer-centric service culture and clear SLAs.

Security, Risk & Compliance — Execution

  • Execute and mature the compliance program — SOC 2 today, with HIPAA being added to this year's audit, alongside NIST and GDPR/California privacy — in partnership with the CTO and our security partners.
  • Run access reviews, vulnerability and patch management, configuration management, and secure cloud/infrastructure practices.
  • Support audits and evidence collection, risk assessments, third-party/vendor risk, and policy enforcement.

Team Leadership & Vendor Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of in-house engineers and specialists (e.g., DBA, DevOps/cloud architect, systems engineer).
  • Orchestrate providers — offshore/nearshore contractors, security-services vendors (MDR/pentest), and an MSP where it pays off (a vCISO if engaged) — with clear SLAs and accountability, and make deliberate build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Own IT and cloud budgets, vendor relationships, procurement, licensing, and contract negotiations.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in cloud/infrastructure operations, DevOps/SRE, or systems engineering, including 3+ years leading technical teams and/or service partners.
  • Hands-on depth operating a production, customer-facing cloud environment for a SaaS or cloud-native product (AWS preferred): compute, networking, storage, and security. Running internal corporate IT — even at a SaaS company — is not a substitute.
  • A demonstrated track record leading a cloud migration and/or standing up a cloud-ops / SRE / DevOps function, with measurable cost and reliability outcomes.
  • Deep, hands-on ownership of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK) and CI/CD for the operational/platform layer — you author and own it, not just deploy what others set up.
  • Practical depth in observability and SLO-based reliability (e.g., Grafana), production incident management and on-call, cloud cost management / FinOps, and backup, disaster recovery, and resilience.
  • Evidence of an AI-forward approach — using automation and AI to increase the leverage of a lean team.
  • Experience managing internal IT in a growing technology or SaaS organization — identity, endpoints, SaaS, and help desk.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance — SOC 2 required; HIPAA, NIST, and privacy (GDPR/CCPA) a strong plus.
  • Experience managing external providers (MSP, MSSP, or contractors; vCISO a plus) and owning vendor budgets.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in the legal, financial, or other regulated / data-sensitive verticals.
  • Familiarity with data-platform operations (data warehouse, CDC/ELT pipelines, analytics).
  • Experience consolidating a multi-cloud / hybrid estate (AWS + Azure + colocation) onto a primary cloud.
  • Relevant certifications: AWS (Solutions Architect / SysOps / DevOps Engineer), plus SRE/DevOps, security (CISSP), or ITIL.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • 2 Company-Wide Mental Health Days
  • Parental Leave Programs
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Broad Equity Participation

Text- und Videotherapie

ifeel – Internationale Plattform für psychische Gesundheit

Ifeel ist eine globale Plattform für psychische Gesundheit, die in über 90 Ländern tätig ist und für ihren evidenzbasierten, klinischen Ansatz sowie ihren Fokus auf das Wohlbefinden von Mitarbeitenden bekannt ist. Wir suchen Psychotherapeut:innen mit gültiger Approbation in Deutschland, die Teil unseres internationalen Netzwerks werden möchten, um Nutzer im Rahmen einer flexiblen, vertraulichen und qualitativ hochwertigen therapeutischen Begleitung zu unterstützen.

Als Therapeut bei ifeel haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Patient über zwei ergänzende Formate zu begleiten:

Videositzungen: 40-minütige Online-Sitzungen, die entsprechend Ihrer Verfügbarkeit und Arbeitssprache geplant werden.

Texttherapie: asynchrone schriftliche Kommunikation, die eine kontinuierliche und flexible Begleitung ermöglicht.

Sie werden Teil eines multikulturellen Netzwerks von Psycholog:innen und profitieren von evidenzbasierten klinischen Tools, einem erfahrenen Clinical Team sowie einem kontinuierlichen Zustrom an Patient in Ihrem jeweiligen Fachbereich.

Requirements

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Psychologie (Bachelor) sowie ein Masterabschluss oder eine therapeutische Weiterbildung im Bereich Psychotherapie, Beratung oder Mental Health, mit in Deutschland anerkanntem Abschluss.

- Erfahrung im Bereich psychologischer Beratung, Therapie oder psychischer Gesundheit von Vorteil.

- Kenntnisse in therapeutischen Ansätzen wie Verhaltenstherapie, systemischer Therapie, humanistischen oder integrativen Verfahren von Vorteil.

- Fähigkeit, selbstständig in einem digitalen Arbeitsumfeld zu arbeiten.

- Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

- Interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Erfahrung mit internationalen oder multikulturellen Patienten von Vorteil.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

Erfahrung im Bereich Telemedizin oder Online-Therapieplattformen.

Mehrsprachigkeit von Vorteil.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass Bewerbungen von Heilpraktiker für Psychotherapie für diese Position leider nicht berücksichtigt werden können.

Benefits

  • Die modernste E-Therapie-Plattform: Nutzen Sie fortschrittliche Online-Therapie-Tools, um Ihre Patient:innen effektiv zu begleiten.
  • Vereinfachtes Patient:innenmanagement: Konzentrieren Sie sich vollständig auf die Bedürfnisse Ihrer Patient:innen, ohne den Aufwand und die Kosten für Marketing oder den Aufbau einer eigenen Website. Wir vermitteln Ihnen Patient:innen ohne zusätzliche Kosten.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice: Genießen Sie die Freiheit, Ihre Arbeitszeiten und Ihren Arbeitsort flexibel zu gestalten.
  • Faire Vergütung pro Sitzung: Sie erhalten eine Vergütung für jede durchgeführte Sitzung und werden somit fair für Ihre wertvolle fachliche Expertise entlohnt.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Unterstützung: Profitieren Sie von regelmäßigen Schulungen und professioneller Unterstützung, um Ihre Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und Ihre berufliche Laufbahn zu fördern.
  • Globale Community: Tauschen Sie sich mit einem vielfältigen Netzwerk von Fachkräften aus der ganzen Welt aus und profitieren Sie von Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Unterstützung.
  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Leisten Sie einen echten Beitrag in einem wachsenden und dynamischen Umfeld.

Wir schätzen Ihr Interesse an ifeel sehr. ifeel ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber:innen werden unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft oder Behinderung berücksichtigt. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir aufgrund des hohen Bewerbungsaufkommens ausschließlich vorausgewählte Bewerber:innen kontaktieren werden.

Die von Ihnen mit uns geteilten Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt und ausschließlich für Zwecke der Bewertung und Auswahl verwendet. Ihr Lebenslauf sowie alle weiteren eingereichten Unterlagen werden gemäß den geltenden Datenschutzbestimmungen während des Bewerbungsprozesses gespeichert und spätestens zwei (2) Jahre nach Abschluss des Auswahlverfahrens gelöscht, sofern keine anderweitige Vereinbarung getroffen wurde. Mit Ihrer Bewerbung erklären Sie sich mit der Verarbeitung Ihrer Daten im Rahmen dieses Bewerbungsprozesses einverstanden.

Onboarding Document Specialist

raw.description:
The Company:

Harvest Hosts is a high-growth travel technology company that manages a portfolio of well-established products and brands in the RV space across North America and Europe. Together, our brands provide a comprehensive suite of offerings to streamline and elevate the RV travel experience. Harvest Hosts is a remote-first company with team members located across the United States and Europe.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Harvest Hosts: offering unique overnight stays at wineries, breweries, distilleries, golf courses, museums, and other scenic small businesses
  • Boondockers Welcome: a community-driven platform connecting RVers with private property hosts
  • Escapees RV Club: one of the largest and most established RV membership organizations
  • CampScanner: an alert service that helps RVers book sold-out campgrounds
  • Brit Stops: a UK and Ireland-based program connecting motorhome travelers with small businesses for overnight stays

What We Do:

We are on a mission to promote happier lives through road travel and support small businesses and communities along the way. Our Host programs connect RV travelers with a diverse network of small businesses, attractions, and private-property Hosts. Host Marketing grows and supports that network across the full Host lifecycle, from quality lead generation and recruitment through activation, education, engagement, and retention. This role primarily supports Harvest Hosts, Boondockers Welcome, and Brit Stops, while collaborating across the broader portfolio when shared campaigns, data, resources, or business priorities require it.

The Position:

We are seeking a highly organized, technically confident, and results-driven Host Marketing Specialist to build and grow a pipeline of qualified Host prospects. This role owns recruiting campaigns from lead generation and campaign build through launch, reporting, and optimization. You'll play a direct role in growing one of North America's largest RV camping networks by connecting thousands of small businesses with a highly engaged community of RV travelers.

Reporting to the Associate Manager of Host Lifecycle, you'll combine hands-on HubSpot execution with audience strategy, data management, content development, and funnel reporting. You will partner with Account Executives, Paid Channels, Brand Marketing, Data, Product, and Events to drive qualified leads. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ideas into action, balancing creativity with operational precision, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of their work.

Responsibilities:

  • Recruiting Campaigns: Plan, launch, and optimize multi-channel Host recruiting campaigns across email, landing pages, direct mail, webinars, events, paid media, and emerging channels.
  • Content and Sales Support: Create polished emails, landing pages, case studies, testimonials, toolkits, sales enablement, event communications, and follow-up assets. Support paid acquisition with lead-quality insights, geographic priorities, and creative recommendations.
  • Lead Generation and Database Quality: Research priority industries and markets; source, enrich, validate, deduplicate, and segment prospect data using approved tools and processes. Maintain verification, suppression, and list-hygiene standards; and document audience sources and outcomes.
  • HubSpot Execution: Build and manage recruiting emails, landing pages, forms, segments, workflows, sequences, properties, lead scoring, routing, personalization, and campaign reporting. Perform thorough quality control before every launch.
  • Project Ownership and Alignment: Coordinate with Account Executives and internal teams on campaign priorities, lead thresholds, routing, follow-up, feedback loops, approvals, and launch readiness. Maintain accurate project plans, communicate status clearly, and escalate risks or support needs early.
  • Analytics and Optimization: Track source and attribution, email and landing-page engagement, lead quality and disqualification, and conversion from initial interest through active Host. Establish performance benchmarks, deliver clear insights, and translate results into actionable improvements that increase lead quality and funnel performance.

Skills and Experience:

  • Experience: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; plus experience in B2B, demand generation, digital, or growth marketing with demonstrated ownership of multi-channel campaigns from build through reporting.
  • Advanced HubSpot Knowledge Required: Ability to independently build and troubleshoot Marketing Hub and CRM emails, forms, landing pages, segments, workflows, sequences, properties, lead scoring, lead routing, automation, and reporting.
  • Lead Generation and Database Management: Strong knowledge of prospect research, list building, data enrichment and validation, segmentation, deduplication, suppression, deliverability, and CRM hygiene. Experience with NeverBounce and AI lead gen tools is a plus.
  • Data and Reporting: Comfort using CRM and full-funnel data to identify trends, explain performance, and recommend next actions; intermediate Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Content and Design: Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, plus basic design skills in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite. Portfolio or work samples demonstrating campaign execution are encouraged.
  • Project and Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage multiple deadlines, maintain accurate plans in Asana or a comparable platform, clarify ownership, document decisions, and communicate effectively across teams.
  • Independent Execution: A demonstrated record of careful quality control, curiosity, proactive problem-solving, follow-through, and reliable execution with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Preferred: Current HubSpot Marketing Hub certification and experience in marketplace, membership, travel, hospitality, small-business, supply-side, or Sales-aligned acquisition programs.

Please note that this position focuses on the supply side of the Harvest Hosts network: the small businesses, attractions, and private-property Hosts where RVers stay overnight. It is not focused on D2C membership growth.

Compensation and Benefits: Harvest Hosts is a fully remote company with team members located across the United States and Europe. Compensation will be based on experience but will range from $50,000 to $60,000 annually, plus eligible bonuses. Benefits include unlimited PTO, health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, parental leave, and most of all, a fun work environment.

Timing: We are looking to fill this position as soon as we find the right candidate!


Remote applicants must be based in the United States and may not work from the following states: CA, HI or AK.

raw.excerpt: About the companyFounded in 2017, rePurpose Global is the leading Packaging Sustainability & Compliance platform for consumer companies.
raw.description:
About the company

Founded in 2017, rePurpose Global is the leading Packaging Sustainability & Compliance platform for consumer companies. We enable brands to measure their plastic footprint, recover plastic waste from nature through a global partner network, and streamline compliance across 45+ packaging regulations — all from one platform.

rePurpose has recovered over 100 million pounds of plastic waste, supported 2,300+ waste workers, and maintains 12 active impact projects worldwide. Our platform helps brands achieve compliance outcomes through advanced data management and regulatory expertise.

Headquartered in New York. Learn more at repurpose.global.

About the Role

    rePurpose Global helps brands meet their Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations across a fast-growing set of U.S. and Canadian jurisdictions, with expansion into global circular economy frameworks. Every defensible compliance filing relies on exact technical truth: precisely defining what a product is made of, then mapping those attributes directly into statutory rules. Dissecting complex BOMs, raw material specs, and material attributes across thousands of SKUs is the technical core of what we do.

    As our Materials & Technical Compliance Engineer, you'll own that core. This is a hands-on material analysis role at heart: you'll break a product or packaging assembly down into its constituent materials, layers, and coatings; determine composition and weights — building the equivalent of a Full Material Disclosure (FMD) when suppliers can't provide one; and translate that into precise classification decisions grounded in the statutory text of each jurisdiction. You'll also help customers move their materials forward — modeling material switches, source-reduction options, and lower-fee alternatives grounded in design-for-circularity principles — and shaping the rules engine behind our proprietary compliance and material optimization platform. It's the meeting point of materials science, regulatory rigor, and applied analysis — engineered to flex across new physical material categories and regulatory regimes as they emerge.

    You'll be the person who resolves the hardest classification and material questions no one else can, and who owns the classification logic that turns material facts into correct reports. You'll work alongside a product and engineering team who build the tools around this logic, serving as the technical authority who informs and grounds that work. Day-to-day, you'll own the technical calls that turn material facts into accurate, defensible reporting and audit-defensible filings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze material composition & BOM structures. Break components down into their materials, layers, formulations, and coatings; determine resin, substrate, or compound types, percentages, and weights; and build defensible assumed compositions and material proxies when supplier specifications are incomplete or missing.

  • Make classification determinations grounded in regulation. Translate material composition into correct reporting classifications for each jurisdiction, reading and applying the relevant statutory and program definitions rather than generalizing across programs.

  • Model material recommendations for customers. Run material-switch, source-reduction, and fee-scenario analyses — identifying more recyclable, lower-fee, or reduced-material alternatives — and translate the tradeoffs (cost, physical performance, and eco-modulation rates) into guidance customers can act on.

  • Own the classification logic. Author and maintain the classification configuration (the routing rules that map material attributes to reporting categories) across jurisdictions, and modernize it as regulation and materials evolve.

  • Run rigorous quality control. Own schema conformance and a multi-pass QC process — checking for material and threshold errors, gaps, overlaps, and misroutes — and provide final technical sign-off on client deliverables.

  • Resolve the hardest technical questions. Serve as the deepest tier of the technical queue for escalated composition, classification, exemption, and mapping questions.

  • Shape our automated recommendation engine. Define the material science, threshold, and specification rules that power our platform's automated material suggestions and compliance routing.

  • Bridge materials science and platform logic. Supply the physical material and regulatory requirements the product and engineering team build against, translating material properties into structured rules for our platform engine. (Supporting the build, not managing it.)

  • Support bespoke material deep-dives. Serve as the home for in-depth, bespoke material analysis and technical recyclability/circularity evaluations for customers.

Requirements

  • A materials or engineering foundation. A degree and/or substantial hands-on background in a materials or engineering discipline — materials science, chemistry, plastics/polymer engineering, textile engineering, packaging science/engineering, industrial or mechanical engineering, or a related field.

  • Material analysis ability. The ability to reason about what products and materials are made of — resins, laminates, coatings, composites, synthetics, or multi-layer assemblies — how those materials behave, and how to estimate composition and weight when data is incomplete.

  • Analytical rigor and precision. Exceptional attention to detail and comfort owning precise, high-stakes analysis and quality-control work where small errors have real reporting and financial consequences.

  • A strong interest in policy and research. The temperament to ground technical decisions in regulatory text, and the diligence to research and defend a determination rather than guess.

  • Clear technical communication. The ability to translate material and regulatory analysis into requirements and explanations that product, engineering, and customer teams can act on.

Nice to Have

    These are a plus, not a requirement — we welcome strong candidates who bring the core profile above.

  • Applied material domain expertise (strongly valued). Hands-on experience working with physical materials — as a raw material supplier, converter, chemical evaluator, or manufacturer — or deep familiarity with material characterization, specs, and processing methods. (Packaging expertise is a strong advantage given our immediate core, but candidates with polymer, textile, or chemical backgrounds are encouraged to apply.)

  • Technical tooling & automation. Comfort with data analysis, ERP structures, or technical software, plus hands-on scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, SQL) to build, test, and streamline the workflows that scale this analysis.

  • EPR / sustainability exposure. Prior work in EPR, compliance, sustainability, or circular economy across the U.S. (e.g., state-level Producer Responsibility Laws), Canada (e.g., PRO programs), or Europe.

  • Lifecycle or recyclability analysis. Familiarity with life-cycle assessment (LCA), design-for-recyclability/circularity protocols, or recycled-content evaluation.

Location Preference:

The role is remote only for US base candidates; for those candidates located near our head office in New York City, this will be a hybrid position with 3 days per week in-office at our office at 1460 Broadway.
We have a truly global team - with members across Miami, New York, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, London, Nairobi, Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, and Jakarta.

We are seeking an experienced Industrial IoT (IIoT) Engineer to design and build connected, data-driven industrial systems spanning the factory floor to enterprise cloud platforms. In this role you will architect end-to-end IIoT solutions, including edge data acquisition, secure connectivity, cloud ingestion, real-time analytics, and operational dashboards. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with practical experience in industrial protocols, edge computing, and cloud IoT platforms. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Implement secure connectivity using mTLS, certificate management, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Build cloud ingestion and processing pipelines using AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, Kafka, or similar.
  • Develop real-time analytics, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance models that turn raw telemetry from industrial assets into actionable signals for operators and reliability engineers.
  • Build operational dashboards and alerts for plant managers and operators.
  • Integrate IIoT data streams with MES, ERP, CMMS, and historian systems, designing reliable bidirectional flows that maintain consistency between operational technology and enterprise systems of record.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of IIoT or industrial software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or Go.
  • Hands-on experience with industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT, Sparkplug B).
  • Experience with at least one major cloud IoT platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with edge runtimes (Greengrass, IoT Edge).
  • Solid understanding of OT/IT integration patterns.
  • Experience with streaming and real-time analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity standards.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with digital-twin platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with predictive maintenance ML models.
  • Exposure to time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB).
  • Familiarity with Unified Namespace (UNS) patterns.
  • Industrial certifications (ISA, IEC 62443).

At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care,a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

The Role

As a Staff Security Engineer, you'll build and deploy the controls, automation, and log pipelines that let a lean security team cover a large and growing surface. Much of the role is hands-on: standing up controls, wiring up tooling, and building the internal tooling that makes the team and our processes better. When the work calls for custom code, you write it yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

You'll sit inside security engineering and work hands-on across our AWS environment, our SIEM, our endpoint fleet, our CI/CD systems, and our application and infrastructure repos. Where a lot of security teams find a problem and hand off a ticket, we implement the fix ourselves, and this person is a big part of how we do that at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own our security log pipelines: get logs out of the systems that produce them, transform and enrich them, and land them in our SIEM where the team can detect and investigate. This is a large part of the role.
  • Operate and improve our SIEM: onboard new sources, and build and tune the detections and alerts the team runs on.
  • Deploy and tune security controls across our endpoint fleet of managed macOS and Windows workstations and AWS WorkSpaces virtual desktops running Windows Server.
  • Build internal tooling and automation that makes the team and our processes better, from removing manual toil in triage and remediation to giving the team capabilities it doesn't have today. When it calls for custom code, it's primarily Python.
  • Instrument our environment for security signal by integrating our tooling through their APIs and writing the connective code that ties the stack together.
  • Establish secure defaults in our Infrastructure as Code through reusable modules and policy as code.
  • Build security into CI/CD: scanning, secrets detection, and policy-as-code gates that live in the developer workflow.
  • Treat the pipelines and tooling you build as a platform you own, including their reliability and coverage.
  • Work directly in systems your team does not own: read the code or infra, make the change safely, and get it through review rather than filing a ticket.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on security engineering with a focus on automation, tooling, and instrumentation.
  • Comfortable writing custom code and scripting, primarily in Python, to build your own tooling and log pipelines from scratch. You do not have to be a career software engineer, but you are well past copy-and-paste.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating log pipelines end to end: collection, parsing, enrichment, and delivery into a SIEM.
  • Hands-on SIEM experience: onboarding sources and building or tuning detections and alerts.
  • Experience deploying and managing endpoint security across a mixed fleet of macOS and Windows workstations, including virtual desktops.
  • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience; Terraform required.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and wiring security checks into them.
  • Working knowledge of a major cloud provider, ideally AWS.
  • Operates independently and drives projects without day-to-day oversight.

Nice to Have

  • A background in Cloud Security or Application Security to build on from a more automation-focused seat.
  • Experience with our stack: Wiz, Cloudflare, GitHub Advanced Security, Spacelift, and AWS-native services.
  • Policy as code experience such as OPA/Rego or Sentinel.
  • Experience with a SIEM or log platform as a pipeline destination.
  • AI/ML security exposure: prompt injection, data poisoning, model abuse, and the controls that mitigate them.
  • PCI-regulated or financial services environment.
  • Familiarity with Ruby on Rails, Python, or Go.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a Driver, not a Passenger. They take an ambiguous problem, find the biggest-impact piece, and start building rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket, and they would rather ship 60% this week and iterate to the rest than spend a quarter on the perfect design. Automating a problem is their first move, and when the fix lives in someone else's system they go make it rather than recommend it. They catch a fragile pipeline or a bad design before it ships, not just the ones they built themselves.

The base annual salary range is listed below. This role is eligible for additional incentives, including an annual bonus.

Base Salary Range
$160,000—$195,000 USD

Why Join Us?

While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:

  • Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs
  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
  • 401(k) matching program
  • Merit advancement opportunities
  • Career development & training

And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.

Beyond Finance does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job positions. No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

About Collectively:

Collectively - part of the Brandtech Group (formerly You & Mr. Jones) - is the global leader in influencer marketing; combining strategy, creative, and technology to deliver the most innovative influencer work. We partner with forward-thinking brands in technology, fashion, retail, gaming, entertainment, consumer goods, and more to build deeply integrated social activation strategies that drive relevance, awareness, and sales. Our work has been recognized by top publications including The Wall Street Journal, Fast Company, Digiday, AdAge, and Business INSIDER, among others. We’ve also earned Effie, Webby, Glossy, IMA Fast Company, and OMMA awards for our programs.

Collectively is known across the industry as the partner who delivers the most creative, strategic, and effective programs, with the most sophisticated analysis and paid social offerings. But most importantly, we’re known to be genuinely committed partners to our clients, many of whom have worked with us for multiple years. We aspire to continue to provide an excellent workplace for our teams while delivering the industry’s most ambitious and thoughtful influencer collaborations. In 2020, we were named by Built In Bay Area as one of the Best Small Companies to work for.

About the Client Partnerships Team

The Client Partnership team leads the strategic and relationship side of our influencer marketing services agency throughout the lifecycle of an account at Collectively–ensuring our partnership with clients is successful, industry-leading and directly in support of our client’s creator marketing ambitions.

This team is focused on cultivating and growing successful relationships with account stakeholders in our client community through best-in-class work and services–delivering strategic influencer marketing proposals/RFPs, industry-leading thought partnership and ongoing strategic direction throughout the lifecycle of our agency/client partnership to support brands in becoming more effective, innovative creator-centric marketers.

This role leads the day-to-day account and strategy workflows for at least 1 and up to 5 brands, and plays a critical for ensuring our creator marketing solutions and strategies are applied practically to our clients businesses.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Manager Business Development to join our Business Development team. This position leads day-to-day account and strategy workflows for 1-5 brands ensuring our creator marketing solutions and strategies translate into real business impact. Reporting to a Director or Sr. Director of Business Development & Account Leadership, you'll sit at the center of proposal development, program delivery, and client relationship-building. Our ideal candidate is organized and is equally comfortable getting into the weeds of research as they are being on a client call.

What You'll Do

  • Lead RFP & proposal development — Digest client briefs, synthesize trends and data, and project-manage responses cross-functionally: shaping influencer campaign strategies, curating agency offerings, building budgets, and presenting partnership approaches.
  • Support client onboarding — Guide Client Strategy teams through net-new account set-up and hand-off, including campaign kick-offs, partnership contracting, administrative workflows, and ensuring a smooth transition to day-to-day account leads.
  • Reporting & analytics collaboration — Partner with Analytics on performance hypotheses, translating learnings into strategic insights and sale enablement materials that drive further revenue growth.
  • Build client relationships — Manage regular touch-points, model strong client service, surface friction points to leadership, and stay fluent in trends, competitors, and industry landscape..

What You'll Bring

  • 3-4 years of direct experience in influencer marketing at an agency or PR firm
  • A balance of data-driven and creative thinking
  • Independent, critical thinking with the confidence to put ideas forward and refine them through feedback
  • Exceptional client servicing instincts and relationship-building skills
  • Strong organization, communication, and time management skills
  • Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
  • BA or equivalent

Requirements

  • Manager: At least 3 years direct experience in influencer marketing at an agency
  • Both left and right brain thinker, equally comfortable with data and creative thinking
  • Independent, critical thinker; comfortable putting ideas backed by rationale and V1s out there, then getting steers from colleagues and clients to refine the work
  • Exceptional client servicing skills and instincts; loves to develop strong relationships with clients
  • Strong organization skills with attention to detail and excellent follow-through
  • Great communication skills—both internally and externally, written and verbal
  • Ability to work efficiently across a variety of tasks and manage time appropriately for projects
  • Thrives in the “undefined” and enjoys fast-changing, fast-paced working environments
  • Collaborative working style with positive attitude and enthusiasm for making great work happen!
  • BA or equivalent

Key Performance Indicators

  • Contributes exceptional and innovative work to assigned accounts by supporting our teams in delivering above & beyond client expectations
  • Demonstrates curiosity with a desire to learn from program data, collaborator content, industry trends and Collectively teammates
  • Self-manages competing assignments and deadlines
  • Goes above and beyond to deliver great work by thinking outside our process and pushing deliverables to be even stronger
  • Exhibits a collaborative and solutions-focused approach
  • Deftly navigates a variety of teams and personalities, creating a collaborative environment to foster great work
  • Remains current on best practices and emerging trends (industry and cultural)
  • Proactively seeks opportunities to improve client work
  • Consistently supports and elevates strategy and thinking in key deliverables across client engagement phases to reflect best-in-class agency work

Benefits & Team Member Experience

  • Medical, Dental & Vision
  • Supplemental Insurances (Life Insurance, Commuter Benefits & Pet Insurance) ● 401k Matching
  • Monthly Work From Home Stipend
  • Remote-First
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • Step Up Recognition Program
  • Collectively Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
  • Virtual & In-Person Events
  • Generous Allotment of Sick Days
  • Birthday PTO

Pay

The pay range for this position is $75,000 – $86,000. Collectively takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs.

Senior SailPoint ISC Engineer

Professional Services / Identity & Access Management | Full-Time

Location: Remote anywhere in the U.S.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) Engineer to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize identity governance solutions for our clients, leveraging SailPoint ISC to solve complex identity and access management challenges. You will work directly with client stakeholders throughout the engagement lifecycle — from discovery and design through implementation, testing, and go-live support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute SailPoint ISC implementation projects for clients across various industries, including configuration of identity sources, access profiles, roles, policies, and workflows
  • Translate client business and compliance requirements into scalable IGA (Identity Governance and Administration) solutions
  • Design and build integrations between SailPoint ISC and target systems (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, databases, custom applications, etc.) using connectors and APIs
  • Develop certifications, access request workflows, separation of duties (SoD) policies, and lifecycle events within ISC
  • Configure and customize workflows using SailPoint’s workflow builder, JavaScript-based rules, and REST/SCIM APIs
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, requirements gathering, and solution design workshops with client stakeholders
  • Provide architecture guidance and best practices for identity governance, role-based access control (RBAC), and access certifications
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues during implementation and post-go-live support
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution design documents, configuration guides, and runbooks
  • Mentor junior consultants and engineers on SailPoint ISC best practices and implementation methodologies
  • Manage multiple concurrent client engagements while maintaining high quality and timely delivery
  • Participate in pre-sales activities, including scoping, level-of-effort estimation, and technical demonstrations as needed
  • Stay current on SailPoint product roadmap, new features, and industry IAM trends

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting SailPoint IdentityNow/Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions
  • Prior experience working in a professional services, consulting, or systems integrator environment, delivering solutions directly to external clients
  • Strong understanding of identity governance concepts: provisioning/deprovisioning, access certifications, SoD, RBAC, lifecycle management, and access requests
  • Experience integrating SailPoint with enterprise systems such as Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, and various databases
  • Proficiency with SailPoint’s workflow engine, JavaScript-based provisioning rules, and REST APIs
  • Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards (SAML, OAuth, SCIM, LDAP)
  • Excellent client-facing communication skills, with the ability to lead workshops and present technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) certification highly preferred
  • Experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) in addition to ISC, including migration projects from IIQ to ISC
  • Experience with scripting/programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Java
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud identity services
  • Background in regulatory/compliance frameworks (SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,200 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option

Overview

Velocity is seeking a Senior Director of Business Development who will lead the development and execution of strategic business development efforts that strengthen relationships with CROs, pharmaceutical companies, and biotech organizations while supporting site teams in delivering an exceptional experience for both clients and patients. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep knowledge of the clinical research landscape, capable of identifying opportunities, building trust with key decision‑makers, and guiding conversations that support meaningful, long‑term partnerships. Success in this position depends not only on strong communication, strategic thinking, and industry expertise, but also a commitment to our core values:
  • Collaborate, by working transparently and respectfully across teams
  • Inspire Change, by bringing fresh perspectives that move our work and our partners forward
  • Care, by prioritizing people and the impact our work has on them
  • Do the Right Thing, by approaching every decision with integrity.

Job Summary

The Senior Director of Business Development is an experienced and dynamic professional who plays a critical role in driving growth and innovation in clinical research. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of medicine, shaping partnerships that accelerate breakthroughs and improve patient outcomes.

This senior-level position requires a seasoned sales leader with a strong background in the clinical research industry. The role focuses on building and nurturing relationships with Clinical Research Organizations (CROs), large pharmaceutical companies, and leading biotech organizations, while collaborating closely with site management teams to ensure operational excellence and deliver superior results for patients and sponsors.

Ideal Candidate

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, outcomes-driven environment and bring a hunter’s mindset to business development. The ideal candidate:
  • Operates with a strong sense of urgency—moves quickly from insight to action, unblocks obstacles, and drives momentum across complex deals.
  • Is highly competitive—sets ambitious targets, tracks performance rigorously, and consistently finds ways to win in the market.
  • Collaborates deeply—works hand-in-hand with site management, operations, and executive leadership to deliver client value and patient impact.
  • Is self-motivated and proactive—identifies opportunities, initiates conversations, and sustains pipeline velocity.

Responsibilities

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive business development strategy to expand our client base within the assigned territory.
  • Identify and prioritize target clients based on market trends, potential opportunities, and revenue potential.
  • Collaborate with the executive team to align business development initiatives with company goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across CROs, pharma, and biotech organizations.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing insights, guidance, and solutions to meet their specific research needs.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, presentations, and negotiations to drive business opportunities forward.
  • Generate leads, qualify prospects, and convert them into clients through effective sales strategies and relationship building.
  • Develop and deliver compelling sales pitches and proposals using a value-focused selling approach.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (business, life sciences, or related discipline) or equivalent years of experience.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of business development experience in clinical research preferred.

We are hiring a Full-Cycle Recruiter to own hiring from first contact to signed offer across our clinics. You will source, screen, and guide candidates through the process for veterinarian (DVM), relief DVM, and Practice Manager roles in a supply-constrained market. This is a hands-on sourcing and closing role, not a coordinator position. Associated Veterinary Partners (AVP) partners with veterinary hospitals and clinics to provide the financial, operational, and strategic resources practices need to thrive while preserving clinical autonomy and quality of care. MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Field Sales Trainer is responsible for driving field force capability development through field coaching, training reinforcement, and National-level pull-through of commercial initiatives. This role partners closely with the National Director, Area Business Directors, Marketing, and Commercial Training to identify performance opportunities, reinforce effective selling behaviors, and support consistent execution of brand strategy across the field sales organization.

The Field Sales Trainer serves as a critical link between field execution and cross-functional commercial strategy by providing insights and feedback on marketing messaging, field strategy, selling skills, field team development opportunities, and training effectiveness.

.Assigned Area: National

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Field Coaching and Sales Capability Development

The Field Sales Trainer will provide in-field coaching and development support to enhance field team effectiveness, execution quality, and customer engagement.

Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct field rides and coaching sessions with sales representatives to reinforce approved selling skills, messaging, and execution standards.
  • Observe customer interactions and provide timely, actionable coaching focused on improving performance and business impact.
  • Identify individual and team development opportunities related to selling skills, clinical acumen, account planning, business ownership, and customer engagement.
  • Support a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and performance excellence across the Nation.
  • Reinforce best practices and desired behaviors aligned to company expectations and commercial objectives.

National-Level Strategy Pull-Through

The Field Sales Trainer will support execution of commercial, marketing, and training initiatives at the National level.

Responsibilities include:

  • Partner with the National Director to support pull-through of brand strategy, field strategy, and national commercial initiatives.
  • Help ensure consistency of approved messaging and selling approaches across regions within the Nation.
  • Support implementation of marketing campaigns, training programs, launch initiatives, and key business priorities.
  • Translate national training and marketing direction into practical field applications.
  • Identify barriers to execution and recommend solutions to improve field adoption and effectiveness.

Insights, Feedback, and Gap Identification

The Field Sales Trainer will provide meaningful insights to leadership and cross-functional partners regarding field execution and market dynamics.

Responsibilities include:

  • Provide regular insights and feedback to the National Director, Area Business Directors, Marketing, and Commercial Training.
  • Identify gaps in marketing messaging, sales resources, field strategy, training content, and field team readiness.
  • Share observations on customer engagement, competitive dynamics, market access considerations, and field execution challenges.
  • Recommend enhancements to training, tools, messaging reinforcement, and coaching approaches.
  • Act as a feedback conduit between field teams and internal commercial stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

The Field Sales Trainer will work closely with commercial leadership and internal partners to support aligned execution.

Responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with Area Business Directors to identify regional performance opportunities and development needs.
  • Partner with Commercial Training to reinforce training programs and provide feedback on training effectiveness.
  • Partner with Marketing to share field insights related to messaging clarity, customer response, resource utilization, and strategic pull-through.
  • Support meetings, workshops, POAs, launch meetings, and other training or commercial events as needed.
  • Influence without direct authority to drive alignment, consistency, and field adoption.

Compliance and Operational Excellence

The Field Sales Trainer is expected to operate with a high degree of professionalism, integrity, and compliance.

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensure all coaching, training reinforcement, and field activities are conducted in accordance with company policies and applicable legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
  • Reinforce the appropriate use of approved materials and messaging.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of field coaching activities, insights, and development themes as required.
  • Demonstrate strong judgment when providing feedback, escalating concerns, and representing field needs to internal stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 7+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or specialty sales experience.
  • Demonstrated success in field sales, launch execution, or competitive market environments.
  • Strong understanding of sales execution, territory management, account planning, and customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, influence, and develop others.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to synthesize field insights and communicate actionable feedback to leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to travel frequently across the nation.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

  • Prior experience in field sales training, sales leadership, mentoring, or coaching roles.
  • Rare disease, Genetics, Endocrine, Metabolics or relevant therapeutic area experience.
  • Experience supporting first-in-class launches or highly competitive markets.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing, Sales Leadership, and Commercial Training.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and ability to translate complex information into clear field application.

You will be responsible for developing untapped accounts, strengthening strategic partnerships, and increasing our presence across core industrial markets.

A strong emphasis will be placed on building a robust sales pipeline, actively developing end-user opportunities, and maintaining close alignment with market trends and competitive activity. Success in this role will come from consistent execution of commercial strategies, effective collaboration with internal teams, and a proactive, opportunity-driven approach to achieving sustainable growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve targets and grow market share.
  • Promote Gates' products across designated markets.
  • Manage key accounts, building strong, long-term relationships.
  • Identify new business opportunities and maintain a robust prospect pipeline.
  • Negotiate contracts and pricing to secure profitable business.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored customer solutions.
  • Drive product and service introductions to meet market demands.
  • Represent Gates at trade shows and industry events.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and contractual obligations.

Keys to Success

  • Requires in-depth knowledge and experience
  • Requires conceptual and practical expertise in own area and general knowledge of related areas
  • Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate the company in the market

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None
  • You will be responsible for selling Gates' products within a defined geographic area. You will research customer needs and effectively develop applications for products and services to support market strategies and objectives for each offering.
  • You will take ownership in addressing communication, trust, and relationship-related concerns, making every effort to resolve issues professionally. You will implement strategies to drive growth of existing products, new product introductions, and entry into new markets.
  • You will monitor the competitive environment to identify opportunities and define appropriate actions to address competition. You will have primary accountability for performance and revenue results within your territory, as well as additional responsibility for strategic initiatives, while managing established accounts in the assigned geographic area.

Requirements and Preferred Skills

  • 5-7 years of experience in the same type of function, preferably manufacturing / power transmission / fluid power/ industrial.
  • Ideally has experience selling through distribution
  • A good standard of Microsoft Office PC /IT skills are required. CRM knowledge is desirable.
  • Must have excellent communication and negotiation skills, good technical background and be able to use Gates' technical data to make drive calculations and recommendations.
  • Excellent follow-up skills are required.
  • Must be a self-starter and be able to work independently.
  • Needs to possess ability to organize activities and be able to manage and function well during times of unexpected events.
  • Must be self-directed, self-motivated and able to work and make decisions with guidelines and limited direction.
  • Must be fluent in English and Dutch and other language skills would be an advantage

Why Gates?

Founded in 1911 in Denver, Colorado, Gates is publicly traded on the NYSE. While we might operate in a vast amount of time zones we operate as 'One Gates' and have a common goal of pushing the boundaries of materials science. We invest in our people, bringing real-world experience that enables us to solve our customers' diverse challenges of today and anticipate those of tomorrow.

I sought a stable position with growth potential and the flexibility to work from home. By July 2021, I was promoted to Recovery Team Lead, where I embraced a leadership and training role within the Recovery Department.In March 2024, I advanced to the position of Quality Assurance Business Analyst, collaborating closely with both the US and Canadian brands. I am enthusiastic about continuing my development and growth with Attain Finance."

~Shannon E. - QA Business Analyst, Attain Finance– Canada

I transitioned into a Team Leader role, where I honed my leadership abilities and was able to guide my team to success.
