No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

Become a part of our caring community

This is a remote position located in Puerto Rico. You must live in Puerto Rico to be eligible, and you must be fluent in both English and Spanish. PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH

As a Bilingual Care Management Support Assistant, you will help members take the next step toward better health and well-being by connecting with them over the phone, completing important non-clinical assessments, identifying barriers to care, and helping them access resources and benefits. This role is ideal for someone who is compassionate, detail-oriented, comfortable in a fast-paced call center environment, and motivated by work that directly supports members and care teams.

The assigned shift will be 11:00 AM–8:00 PM Eastern Standard Time / 12:00 PM–9:00 PM during Daylight Saving Time.

What You Will Do

  • Engage members by phone to encourage participation in care management programs.
  • Complete required assessments and questionnaires to help identify health risks, care needs, and opportunities for clinical team follow-up.
  • Assist members who need support scheduling doctor’s appointments or connecting with appropriate care resources.
  • Identify and help address barriers to preventive screenings, benefits, and health-related services so members can close gaps in care.
  • Support members in understanding, retaining, and accessing benefits that contribute to their overall health and well-being.
  • Manage both inbound and outbound calls in an auto-dialer environment while documenting member information.

What Success Looks Like

  • You create a positive member experience by treating each interaction with respect, patience, and professionalism
  • You demonstrate compassion, integrity, and sound judgment when supporting members with sensitive health-related needs
  • You listen to understand member needs, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and solve problems within established guidelines
  • You stay up to date with department guidelines and apply training, tools, and procedures in your daily work
  • You work independently, manage your time, and ask for guidance when clarification is needed
  • You remain flexible and focused while adapting to changing healthcare priorities, member needs, and business processes

Training and Schedule Expectations

  • Call center hours of operation are Monday-Friday between 8:00 am and 8:00 pm EST
  • The assigned shift for this opportunity will be: 11:00 am – 8:00 pm EST
  • During the first 2 weeks of training, hours will be 9 am to 5:30 pm EST
  • We consider attendance vital for your success; we will not allow any time off during the 2-week training period.
  • Management must approve time off during the first 90 days ahead of time.
  • We offer extended hours when needs arise. This could include occasional mandatory overtime to include evenings and weekends.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish, with the ability to pass required language proficiency assessments in both languages
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience managing high-volume inbound and outbound calls
  • Experience meeting documented productivity, quality, or service performance metrics
  • Experience navigating, documenting, and updating member or customer information across multiple applications, programs, and platforms
  • Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook to complete daily work tasks, manage communications, track information, and maintain accurate documentation
  • Ability to work a scheduled 8-hour shift, including a 1-hour lunch, between 11:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST as assigned

Additional Information

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Interview Format

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an interviewing technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. HireVue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule.

  • Text Prescreen: Shortly after submitting your application, you may receive both a text message and email requesting you to complete prescreen questions with either yes or no answers. The text message may arrive prior to the email. If you prefer to answer via computer or tablet, wait for the email.
  • Video Prescreen: If you are successful with the text prescreen, you will receive another communication to record a Video Prescreen. This is an online video activity using your phone, tablet, or computer; however, most candidates prefer using a computer or tablet.
  • Interviews: Some candidates will be invited to interview. If so, the recruiter will send an invitation through Hire Vue to schedule a day and time.
  • Offers: Finalists from the interview will be contacted by a recruiter to discuss the offer and benefits for the job
  • Note: Depending on the number of openings, the number of candidates who apply, and the schedules of interviewers and recruiters, this process may take several weeks or less; however, know that we are working hard to proceed as quickly as possible and to keep you informed.

Work-At-Home

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$32,000 - $41,800 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. raw.excerpt: About CorpsAfricaCorpsAfrica was founded in 2011 by former Peace Corps Volunteer Liz Fanning after young Africans asked how they could become Peace Corps Volunteers to serve their own country.
raw.description:
About CorpsAfrica

CorpsAfrica was founded in 2011 by former Peace Corps Volunteer Liz Fanning after young Africans asked how they could become Peace Corps Volunteers to serve their own country. She had to tell them that the program was open only to Americans, so she created CorpsAfrica, an NGO that recruits and trains young Africans to live and serve in rural communities, listening to the people and facilitating community-led development projects.

Since launching its first Volunteer cohort in Morocco in 2013, CorpsAfrica has expanded to 11 African countries. More than 1,700 Volunteers have completed service, partnering with communities to implement small-scale high-impact projects that are identified by local people, improving the lives of nearly one million people across the continent. Learn more at .

Purpose of this Assignment

CorpsAfrica is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Grant Writer to support the organization’s funding proposal pipeline across multiple countries of service in Africa.

This contractor will support the identification of funding opportunities, maintain the proposal pipeline, and prepare high-quality proposals. The role requires strong writing, organizational, and project management skills, along with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and multicultural environment. Well-qualified candidates should be able to manage multiple priorities independently while delivering accurate, timely, and compelling donor materials.

Engagement Type

Independent consultancy, temporary basis

Location

Remote, with availability aligned to US East Coast operating hours

Reports To

Fundraising Lead

Duration

Six months, with the possibility of extension

Level of Effort

15 to 20 hours per month

Application Deadline

August 21, 2026

Scope of Work

The contractor will:

Grants Prospecting and Reporting System

  • Support and utilize established organizational systems to track grant prospecting, active pipelines, and upcoming reporting schedules.
  • Maintain accurate system records to track proposal status, submission schedules, and compliance deadlines.

Proposal and Report Drafting

  • Draft, edit, and refine high-quality grant proposals, concept notes, and donor reports tailored specifically to funder guidelines and CorpsAfrica's strategic priorities.
  • Translate complex program impact and field data into clear, compelling, donor-ready narratives.
  • Ensure all tailored content meets strict funder compliance and structural requirements.

Funding Research and Pipeline Management

  • Conduct comprehensive research to discover new institutional, corporate, and foundation funding streams.
  • Maintain and expand the foundation proposal pipeline.
  • Support country office Philanthropy Officers with prospecting, tracking, and proposal documentation.

Grants Planning and Tracking

  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership to design, implement, and monitor milestones within CorpsAfrica’s annual grants management plan.
  • Monitor progress toward planned targets and regularly report progress and status updates.

Deliverables

Timelines will be agreed at the start of the engagement. The contractor will be expected to produce the following.

  1. Submission-ready, compelling proposals and donor reports that satisfy all strict funder compliance and structural requirements.
  2. Provide regular, documented pipeline status updates to support tracking upcoming deadlines and active funding opportunities.
  3. Documented grant prospect research profiles identifying viable institutional, corporate, and foundation funding sources.
  4. Milestone progress updates aligned with CorpsAfrica's annual grants management plan.

Qualifications and Experience

Required:

  • Proven experience in grant writing, research, and grant lifecycle management.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to track multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate program impact into donor-ready content.
  • Experience supporting a dispersed team across multiple countries and demonstrated cross-cultural sensitivity.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision, prioritizing tasks effectively while delivering high-quality proposals and reports on time.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with grant management software or CRM systems.
  • Working knowledge of international development funding mechanisms and sub-Saharan African operating contexts.
  • Working proficiency in French, given CorpsAfrica's Francophone operations.

Reporting and Working Arrangements

The contractor will report directly to the Fundraising Lead and will coordinate day-to-day with the GSO Fundraising team and members of senior management as necessary.

This is a remote engagement. The contractor will participate in a kickoff meeting to agree on priorities and pipeline tracking processes, followed by regular check-ins and availability for scheduled grant milestones. The grants office is a growing department within CorpsAfrica’s fundraising team. There is both flexibility and room for growth in the position.

Duration and Level of Effort

This engagement is expected to run for 3 to 6 months from the start date, with the possibility of extension based on performance and organizational needs. The estimated level of effort will be determined upon final engagement agreements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit the following through JazzHR:

  1. A cover letter describing relevant experience and approach to supporting a multi-country nonprofit
  2. A resume or curriculum vitae
  3. A financial proposal setting out proposed rates on an hourly basis, inclusive of all taxes and expenses
  4. Two professional references from comparable engagements

Evaluation Criteria

Applications will be evaluated on demonstrated grant writing success, experience with nonprofit or donor-funded organizations, cross-cultural capability, clarity and compelling style of written communication, availability and responsiveness, and value for money.

CorpsAfrica is an equal opportunity organization and welcomes applications from qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Thank you for your interest in CorpsAfrica. Due to the large number of applications we receive, we regret that we are only able to contact shortlisted candidates.

Bounteous is seeking a CDP Consultant to help clients unlock the value of their customer data through Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), with a focus on Adobe Real-Time CDP.   • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets

  • Manage incoming platform-related requests and collaborate with internal teams to prioritize and deliver CDP enhancements and activation initiatives.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team to coordinate delivery timelines and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide hands-on guidance and enablement to client teams, helping them operationalize CDP capabilities and maximize value from their marketing technology investments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working in an agency environment; strong consulting, and client-facing skills
  • 3+ years of experience working with CDPs, specifically Adobe RTCDP
  • Strong understanding of customer data platforms and the modern data infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience configuring Adobe Real-Time CDP, including creating complex audiences

  • Experience with marketing automation tools is a plus
  • Experience with A/B testing tools is a plus
  • College degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Data Science or related field

Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a CDP Consultant to help clients unlock the value of their customer data through Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), with a focus on Adobe Real-Time CDP. In this role, you will serve as a strategic consultant helping organizations translate business goals into scalable CDP use cases that enable audience activation, personalization, and cross-channel engagement.

This position sits within our Technology team and works closely with Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Marketing Strategists, and digital marketing specialists to bring data-driven customer experiences to life. The consultant leads discovery efforts, supports activation strategies, and partners with business and technical teams to design solutions that deliver measurable marketing outcomes.

Success in this role requires a strong consulting mindset, a passion for marketing technology, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear insights for clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying opportunities to better leverage customer data to power modern digital marketing.

While the immediate need is Adobe RTCDP expertise, candidates must be willing to learn and support a variety of CDP and marketing automation platforms in this role.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the day-to-day platform consultant for clients, providing strategic guidance on Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities, use cases, and activation strategies.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business objectives, marketing strategy, and available customer data to ensure CDP initiatives support measurable marketing outcomes.
  • Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and requirements gathering to identify opportunities for CDP-driven marketing use cases.
  • Translate marketing and business requirements into clear CDP business and technical requirements for identity resolution, data governance, data modeling, data ingestion, segmentation, channel activation, and audience reporting in partnership with Solution Architects and engineering teams.
  • Support product and strategy teams to prioritize activation-focused CDP use cases that support segmentation, personalization, and cross-channel customer engagement.
  • Define activation strategies that leverage downstream orchestration channels such as paid media, email, SMS, web personalization, and other channels commonly found in marketing automation platforms.
  • Partner with other platform consultants to create and maintain solution documentation for CDP and orchestration platforms.
  • Serve as the platform subject matter expert for each client’s CDP implementation, advising on platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
  • Manage incoming platform-related requests and collaborate with internal teams to prioritize and deliver CDP enhancements and activation initiatives.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team to coordinate delivery timelines and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide hands-on guidance and enablement to client teams, helping them operationalize CDP capabilities and maximize value from their marketing technology investments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working in an agency environment; strong consulting, and client-facing skills
  • 3+ years of experience working with CDPs, specifically Adobe RTCDP
  • Strong understanding of customer data platforms and the modern data infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience configuring Adobe Real-Time CDP, including creating complex audiences

About Us

Little Sleepies is one of the fastest growing companies in America, according to Inc. Magazine (#1 in retail)! We make days and nights easier with super-soft yet impressively durable, thoughtfully designed products that families love. Featuring prints kids are obsessed with and fabrics parents trust, every piece is made to feel good, fit right, and get worn on repeat. We're rooted in innovation and driven by care, with our signature fabrics, Lunaluxe® and Soluxe®, custom-developed to support the way kids move, sleep, and grow — because comfort isn't just how it feels, it's how it's made. Driven by creativity, passion, and the desire to do something extraordinary, we strive to bring joy and comfort to families around the world. We're excited to be doing this, and we hope you will be too. If our mission resonates, we would love to hear from you!

Location:

Remote - within the United States

Visa Sponsorship:

This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.

The Role:

Little Sleepies is growing fast, and so is the systems and automation backbone that keeps us moving. We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator / Engineer to join our Systems team and take hands-on ownership of the platforms and automations our teams rely on every day. This is a balanced role: part enterprise systems administrator keeping our core applications healthy and well supported, and part automation engineer building the integrations and workflows that let a lean team punch well above its weight.

You will work closely with the Director of Systems and partner with teams across Photography, Product, Compliance and Integrity, Production, Marketing, Lifecycle, eCommerce, and Finance. Day to day, you will build and improve automations in tools like Airtable and n8n, write scripts and API integrations that connect our systems, and provide high-touch support that keeps everyone unblocked. We lean into modern, AI-assisted development, so you will use tools like Claude to build, document, and maintain solutions quickly and thoughtfully. If you love turning manual, error-prone processes into clean, reliable, automated ones, and you like owning systems end to end, this role is for you.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build, and maintain automations and integrations across our stack using n8n, APIs, webhooks, and custom scripts, connecting systems so data flows reliably between them.
  • Own and continuously improve our Airtable environment, including bases, interfaces, automations, and scripting, that Photography, Compliance and Integrity, and Production use to run their day-to-day work, tightening timelines and reducing manual effort.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude to accelerate how you build, document, and maintain automations, scripts, and integrations.
  • Handle day-to-day administration of our enterprise applications, including NetSuite (users, roles and permissions, saved searches, record and field maintenance), and troubleshoot sync issues across NetSuite, Shopify, and connected systems.
  • Provide high-touch, systems-specific technical support that goes beyond first-line helpdesk, and serve as a reliable second owner and backup across our automations and enterprise systems.
  • Help monitor and maintain our data pipelines and Snowflake environment so Marketing, Lifecycle, Finance, and Analytics teams have dependable, timely data.
  • Document systems, workflows, and runbooks, and follow through with continuous improvements after issues are resolved.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • 5+ years in systems administration, IT engineering, or automation and integration engineering, ideally in a fast-moving company.
  • Advanced Airtable or similar relation database systems expertise, including complex bases, interfaces, automations, and scripting.
  • Strong workflow automation experience with n8n (or a comparable platform) and a track record of building API and webhook integrations between SaaS systems.
  • Solid scripting skills (JavaScript and/or Python) and comfort working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication such as OAuth.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude to build and maintain automations and integrations.
  • Experience administering enterprise business applications, including NetSuite (users, roles, saved searches, and general administration).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts, a bias for ownership and follow-through, clear documentation habits, and the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred

  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and SQL for monitoring and maintaining data pipelines.
  • Identity and access administration (Okta), endpoint management (Jamf and/or Intune), and Google Workspace administration.
  • Experience supporting e-commerce and retail operations systems such as Shopify Plus, digital asset management platforms, and customer experience platforms such as Zendesk, Gladly, or Richpanel.
  • Experience supporting data, analytics, and finance reporting needs.

What we’re excited to offer you:

  • Ability to work cross functionally with a fast-growing team, with smile-sparking products that turn everyday moments into magical memories
  • A supportive environment that fosters and encourages new ideas and innovation
  • The opportunity to stock your drawers with Little Sleepies! Free pajamas & Play product when you join (and every year on your work anniversary!) and a generous employee discount all year long to keep you cozy

  • Home office stipend

  • Company-issued computer

Little Sleepies is an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Lead Product Owner conveys product vision and roadmap priorities to Agile teams through backlog management, feature input, user story development, and stakeholder engagement. The Lead Product Owner works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The Lead Product Owner maximizes the value of products delivered by Agile teams supporting Electronic Prior Authorization (ePA) APIs, FHIR-based interoperability solutions, and regulatory compliance initiatives. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, compliance teams, product management, architects, and delivery teams to ensure regulatory requirements are translated into scalable technology solutions that meet business and customer needs.

The Lead Product Owner is accountable for backlog prioritization, feature input, user story development, acceptance criteria definition, and delivery execution. This role works closely with the Lead Product Manager, other PO's and business stakeholders to understand CMS interoperability regulations, prior authorization requirements, implementation timelines, and industry standards. The Lead Product Owner ensures delivery teams have the context and direction required to successfully execute strategic initiatives while balancing compliance, business value, and technical priorities.

Serves as the Agile team's primary contact for information, work prioritization, and decision-making. Exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues regarding regulatory interpretation, product execution, stakeholder alignment, and delivery priorities. Works under minimal supervision and uses independent judgment requiring analysis of variable factors and determination of the best course of action. Able to guide and mentor others to help develop best practices.


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Manager, or related role supporting healthcare technology initiatives.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and Agile product management tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira.
  • Experience translating complex business, regulatory, and operational requirements into user stories and product backlogs.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare interoperability concepts, APIs, and healthcare data exchange workflows.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Compliance, Operations, and Business stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience facilitating requirements discussions, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and user acceptance activities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Doctorate degree and 5 years of biopharmaceutical commercialization, global strategy execution, or program management experience

Master’s degree and 8 years of biopharmaceutical commercialization, global strategy execution, or program management experience

Job Description:

Lead Business Data Analyst

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The LeadBusiness Data Analyst will work as part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will serve as the lead primary bridge between federal business stakeholders and the CMM Data Modernization and Governance technical delivery teams, ensuring requirements are accurately captured, governed, and translated into high-quality data products. This role supports data modernization by driving requirements management, source-to-target mappings, data governance coordination, and documentation required to deliver compliant, auditable, and mission-aligned reporting, analytics, and AI/ML solutions.

The LeadBusiness Data Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Lead elicitation, analysis, and documenting business, functional, and data requirements for CMM data products and analytics.
  • Lead development and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs), workflows, and data requirements documentation.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops, working sessions, and governance meetings, capturing decisions and action items.
  • Translate statutory, operational, and reporting needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Support data governance coordination, ensuring alignment with standards, policies, and stewardship decisions.
  • Partner with data engineers and architects to validate data models, transformations, and reporting logic.
  • Ensure requirements incorporate data classification, security, and access control considerations.
  • Support testing activities, including test planning, validation of results, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Produce and maintain Agile artifacts (backlogs, user stories, traceability matrices).
  • Contribute to metadata catalog ingestion by defining business definitions and data attributes.
  • Support training, documentation, and communication for CMM data products users.
  • Ensure all documentation is audit-ready, version-controlled, and SOW-compliant.
  • Operates within an Agile federal delivery environment supporting multiple scrum teams.
  • Collaborates closely with business owners, data engineers, architects, and governance teams.
  • Accountable for requirements of accuracy, traceability, and documentation quality.
  • Expected to maintain audit-ready artifacts and timely deliverables.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree with 7+ years or BS/BA degree with 9+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Experience assisting with testing, writing acceptance criteria and confirming test cases results.
  • Experience with producing relevant and current requirements, sizing user stories correctly, and removing roadblocks prior to sprints start.
  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst on enterprise IT or data programs.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting cloud data platforms, analytics, or data initiatives.
  • Strong expertise in requirements management, data analysis, and documentation.
  • Experience working in federal or regulated environments (plus).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Proven ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting federal judiciary or justice-related programs.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality practices.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3/Redshift/QuickSight preferred).
  • Experience supporting statutory or compliance-driven reporting.
  • Mentoring or lead-analyst experience.
  • Experience with SQL (read-only analysis).
  • Experience with STTM and data mapping tools.
  • Experience with BI and Reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight.
  • Extensive experience with Jira and Confluence for backlog management and documentation.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platform supporting operational data, reporting, and analytics delivering cloud-based architecture (data lake, lakehouse, or data warehouse).
  • Familiarity with Data Platform & Architecture, Data Engineering & Integration, Data Migration & Archiving & Disaster Recovery tools and services.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)

  • CBAP or CCBA
  • PMI-PBA
  • SAFe Agilist (for Agile programs)

COMMUNICATION & ORGANIZATIONAL

  • Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

raw.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Enterprise Sales VP, you'll be embedded in the Enterprise Sales team and report directly to the VP, Public and Labor.

The Enterprise Sales VP, Public Sector will expand our footprint with large public-sector clients through direct sales. This is an individual contributor seat with a defined national territory: a named book of public-sector entities at 10,000 to 100,000 lives, including school districts, cities, counties, universities, and public benefit pools. We are expanding our team in order to continue to hit our ambitious Enterprise Sales goals. We are searching for a candidate who possesses the exceptional ability to establish and cultivate high-level relationships, as this will be instrumental in our pursuit of growth and innovation.

What you will do

  • Own the direct sales cycles and deploy sales objectives through the preparation and measuring of sales quotas, prospecting and pipeline management across a named national book of public-sector entities
  • Run RFP-driven pursuits end to end: procurement compliance, consultant management, finalist presentations, and board and committee approvals, across 9 to 18 month, multi-stakeholder cycles
  • Keep current with market knowledge and competitor products to effectively communicate the value proposition of a relationship with Garner
  • Support the development of new, strategic relationships with public-sector benefits consultants and benefits directors, and influence the buying decision

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of deep sales experience with a focus on health benefits (medical, ancillary, vendor) via brokers, consultants, and insurers
  • 5+ years selling into public-sector entities strongly preferred, with deep fluency in public procurement mechanics: RFP cycles, evaluation scoring, protest risk, sunshine laws, and board dynamics
  • Existing relationships within the public-sector consultant ecosystem (including the public practices at Segal, Aon, WTW, Mercer, and Gallagher) and with public-sector benefits directors
  • Minimum of 3+ years experience selling large Enterprise clients
  • A data literacy with the ability to turn complex, disparate datasets into insights that drive actions
  • Proven experience with developing processes (sales playbooks, KPIs, collateral creation, etc), and executing on sales strategies to promote long term success
  • A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team's metrics.

What you'll get here

You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you'll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It's demanding by design. You'll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Where you will work:

Garner is headquartered in NYC, but this position is available for individuals who are comfortable with remote work and occasional travel to HQ.

Visa sponsorship:Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation

The target total comp (inclusive of base + bonus) range for this role is $425,000 - $475,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.

Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that's what you're looking for, we'd love to meet you.

The U.S. Endoluminal Program Manager/ Ion Clinical Sales Manager reports to the Endoluminal Program Director. The EPM plays a critical role in building and developing the clinical field sales team within their region. The major responsibilities are to manage and direct the program launches and utilization of the ION System within their installed base. This will include managing installations, training and utilization growth within their assigned region and the hiring, training, and development of ESR/ETA team.

Essential Job Duties

  • Hire, train and develop the clinical team in their region.
  • Manage the program launches of the ION system.
  • Expand ION procedure usage in all existing accounts
  • Manage training and education process within installed base
  • Support KOL development across region

Required Skills and Experience

Required Education and Training

Bachelor’s degree required

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

raw.title: Capture Excellence - Cost Estimator
raw.excerpt: Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services.
raw.description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.

POSITION SUMMARY

THE COST ESTIMATOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DEVELOPING ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES AND FINANCIAL MODELS THAT SUPPORT BID AND PROPOSAL ACTIVITIES ACROSS FRANKLIN ENERGY. WORKING CLOSELY WITH THE PRINCIPAL COST ESTIMATOR AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL TEAMS INCLUDING BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, CLIENT DELIVERY, FINANCE, ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SOLUTIONS, AND STRATEGY, THIS ROLE DEVELOPS PRICING MODELS, ANALYZES COST INPUTS, AND SUPPORTS COMPETITIVE PRICING STRATEGIES FOR NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES.

THE COST ESTIMATOR PLAYS A KEY ROLE IN ENSURING PROPOSALS ARE FINANCIALLY SOUND, DATA-DRIVEN, AND ALIGNED WITH ORGANIZATIONAL GOALS. THIS POSITION REQUIRES STRONG ANALYTICAL SKILLS, ATTENTION TO DETAIL, AND THE ABILITY TO COLLABORATE WITH MULTIPLE STAKEHOLDERS TO GATHER INPUTS, EVALUATE ASSUMPTIONS, AND DELIVER CLEAR AND ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES WITHIN TIGHT PROPOSAL TIMELINES.

THIS ROLE ALSO CONTRIBUTES TO MAINTAINING ESTIMATING TOOLS, ANALYZING HISTORICAL PROPOSAL DATA, AND IDENTIFYING OPPORTUNITIES TO IMPROVE PRICING ACCURACY AND ESTIMATING EFFICIENCY.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

  • Develop cost estimates and pricing models for proposals and new business opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Business Development, Client Delivery, Engineering, Product Solutions, and Finance teams to gather cost inputs and validate assumptions.
  • Build and maintain detailed financial models and pricing templates that support proposal development.
  • Analyze labor, operational, and program cost drivers to ensure accurate and competitive pricing.
  • Support the development of price-to-win strategies through financial modeling and scenario analysis.
  • Review proposal inputs to ensure cost assumptions are reasonable, consistent, and aligned with program requirements.
  • Maintain documentation and version control for pricing models and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze historical bid data and pricing trends to inform future estimating efforts.
  • Assist in the development and refinement of standardized estimating tools and templates.
  • Support reporting and analysis related to proposal performance, pricing accuracy, and estimating trends.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives to streamline estimating workflows and improve data quality.
  • Provide financial analysis and insights to support proposal teams and leadership decision-making.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or related field required.
  • 3–5 years of experience in cost estimating, financial analysis, pricing, budgeting, or related analytical roles.
  • Experience supporting bid and proposal development processes preferred.
  • Experience in energy, engineering, construction, consulting, government contracting, or infrastructure-related industries is a plus.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.
  • Ability to analyze cost drivers and translate operational inputs into structured pricing models.
  • High attention to detail and ability to ensure accuracy in complex financial models.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple proposal timelines simultaneously.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across multiple departments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret financial data and provide actionable insights.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and respectful collaboration.
  • Committed to diversity and inclusion
  • Reliable transportation

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Experience with PowerBI, financial modeling tools, or ERP systems preferred.
  • Ability to work with data visualization or reporting tools is a plus.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Valid driver’s license

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel up to 10%

Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position. An Equal Opportunity Employer

Safety -Sensitive Role Addendum:

Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

raw.title: Head of IT
raw.excerpt: About CenterbaseAt Centerbase, we empower mid-size law firms to run their practices more efficiently, profitably, and client-centrically.
raw.description:
About Centerbase
At Centerbase, we empower mid-size law firms to run their practices more efficiently, profitably, and client-centrically. Our cloud-based legal practice management platform streamlines the entire client lifecycle from intake to billing to business intelligence, helping attorneys deliver exceptional service while achieving their growth goals.
We’re more than just a software provider—we’re a partner in transformation. With a focus on automation, flexibility, and continuous innovation, we give firms the tools to modernize operations, improve collaboration, and adapt to the evolving expectations of today’s clients and legal professionals. At Centerbase, we come to work every day committed to making legal work easier, smarter, and more impactful for the firms and communities we serve.
Everything we do is guided by four core values:
  • Customer Centric
  • Stronger Together
  • Be the Difference
  • Relentless Improvement
These values shape who we are: a dedicated, inventive, and passionate team committed to empowering law firms to achieve lasting growth and success.

Summary

Centerbase is seeking a hands-on Director, Cloud & IT Operations to lead the operational backbone of our cloud-driven business through an active migration and beyond. Reporting to the CTO, you'll own the day-to-day across our cloud environment — as we consolidate onto AWS from a mix of Azure and colocation — plus our internal IT and corporate systems and the execution of our security and compliance programs, keeping Centerbase secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient as we grow.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll land the cloud migration and stand up modern operations — DevOps, observability, incident response, and cost discipline — while leading a lean team of employees and specialized service partners. You'll bring an AI-forward mindset to force-multiply a small team, and you'll know when to build in-house versus leverage providers.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Operations — Land the Migration & Own It · the priority

  • Land the in-flight consolidation onto AWS (from Azure and colocation), then run best-practice cloud operations: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and release/change management.
  • Build observability and performance monitoring — metrics, logging, tracing, and SLOs/SLIs — and drive down alert noise and mean-time-to-resolution.
  • Own the production incident and issue-resolution process: severity levels, on-call, runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  • Ensure reliability and resilience — high availability, backup, disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), and regular DR testing.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps on operational readiness and the platform-vs-product infrastructure boundary.
  • Bring an AI-forward approach to operations — use automation and AI to force-multiply a lean team across monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and cost analysis.

Cloud Cost Management (FinOps)

  • Own a growing cloud spend: cost visibility and tagging, rightsizing, commitments (Savings Plans / Reserved Instances), budgets, and anomaly detection — keeping the migration cost-disciplined.
  • Drive continuous cost optimization and cost accountability across teams.
  • Rationalize the SaaS and tooling portfolio (including AI tools) — consolidate overlapping tools and renegotiate vendors.

Internal IT & Corporate Technology

  • Own the internal IT ecosystem — networks, endpoints, productivity tools, and identity management.
  • Run onboarding/offboarding, role-based access controls, and device lifecycle management.
  • Manage third-party SaaS systems and integrations; drive automation and a strong employee-IT experience.
  • Oversee help desk operations with a customer-centric service culture and clear SLAs.

Security, Risk & Compliance — Execution

  • Execute and mature the compliance program — SOC 2 today, with HIPAA being added to this year's audit, alongside NIST and GDPR/California privacy — in partnership with the CTO and our security partners.
  • Run access reviews, vulnerability and patch management, configuration management, and secure cloud/infrastructure practices.
  • Support audits and evidence collection, risk assessments, third-party/vendor risk, and policy enforcement.

Team Leadership & Vendor Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of in-house engineers and specialists (e.g., DBA, DevOps/cloud architect, systems engineer).
  • Orchestrate providers — offshore/nearshore contractors, security-services vendors (MDR/pentest), and an MSP where it pays off (a vCISO if engaged) — with clear SLAs and accountability, and make deliberate build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Own IT and cloud budgets, vendor relationships, procurement, licensing, and contract negotiations.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in cloud/infrastructure operations, DevOps/SRE, or systems engineering, including 3+ years leading technical teams and/or service partners.
  • Hands-on depth operating a production, customer-facing cloud environment for a SaaS or cloud-native product (AWS preferred): compute, networking, storage, and security. Running internal corporate IT — even at a SaaS company — is not a substitute.
  • A demonstrated track record leading a cloud migration and/or standing up a cloud-ops / SRE / DevOps function, with measurable cost and reliability outcomes.
  • Deep, hands-on ownership of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation / CDK) and CI/CD for the operational/platform layer — you author and own it, not just deploy what others set up.
  • Practical depth in observability and SLO-based reliability (e.g., Grafana), production incident management and on-call, cloud cost management / FinOps, and backup, disaster recovery, and resilience.
  • Evidence of an AI-forward approach — using automation and AI to increase the leverage of a lean team.
  • Experience managing internal IT in a growing technology or SaaS organization — identity, endpoints, SaaS, and help desk.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance — SOC 2 required; HIPAA, NIST, and privacy (GDPR/CCPA) a strong plus.
  • Experience managing external providers (MSP, MSSP, or contractors; vCISO a plus) and owning vendor budgets.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in the legal, financial, or other regulated / data-sensitive verticals.
  • Familiarity with data-platform operations (data warehouse, CDC/ELT pipelines, analytics).
  • Experience consolidating a multi-cloud / hybrid estate (AWS + Azure + colocation) onto a primary cloud.
  • Relevant certifications: AWS (Solutions Architect / SysOps / DevOps Engineer), plus SRE/DevOps, security (CISSP), or ITIL.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • 2 Company-Wide Mental Health Days
  • Parental Leave Programs
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Broad Equity Participation

Numeris est la source la plus fiable et reconnue en matière de données d’auditoire et comportementales des consommateurs au Canada. En plus d’être une autorité en termes d’intelligence d’affaires auprès des diffuseurs, annonceurs et agences de publicité, depuis plus de 75 ans, Numeris se distingue en étant la référence en intelligence d’auditoire.
Nous avons des gens formidables qui font un travail exceptionnel. Nous instaurons avec fierté un environnement propice à la formation continue et aux possibilités d’avancement professionnel. Nos équipes, axées sur la collaboration et la curiosité, se dévouent à offrir une expérience de qualité. Nous adorons ce que nous faisons, aimons travailler ensemble, et appuyons des initiatives pour contribuer à la communauté. Nous sommes à la recherche de talents pour nous aider à façonner l’avenir de Numeris tout en ayant du plaisir.
Numeris is Canada’s most trusted and authoritative source for broadcast measurement and consumer behaviour data. As well, the industry leading intelligence provider to broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies. We have been recognized for over 75 years as providing the gold standard in audience intelligence.
We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each other’s company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. We are looking for people to help us shape the future of Numeris, and have a lot of fun along the way.
Le Coordonnateur, Réussite client est responsable de coordonner les communications destinées aux clients, de tenir à jour la documentation client, de soutenir les lancements de produits et de contribuer à l’intégration, à la formation et à l’administration des comptes clients. Le rôle agit également comme point central de coordination pour les demandes internes et les initiatives interfonctionnelles, contribuant à ce que les projets soient réalisés de façon efficace et uniforme tout en maintenant un niveau élevé de service à la clientèle.

The Customer Success Coordinator is responsible for coordinating client-facing communications, maintaining customer documentation, supporting product releases, and assisting with customer onboarding, training, and account administration. The role also serves as a central point of coordination for internal requests and cross-functional initiatives, helping ensure projects are completed efficiently and consistently while maintaining a high standard of customer service.

What you will do | Ce que vous ferez

    Communications sur les produits et documentation

    • Coordonner les communications destinées aux clients concernant les produits, y compris les notes de version, les avis de service et les annonces techniques, en collaboration avec l’équipe Marketing.

    • Tenir à jour la documentation destinée aux clients, y compris les articles de soutien, les guides d’utilisation, les tableaux de bord et les rapports mensuels aux clients.

    • Coordonner les demandes entre les équipes Marketing, Produits, Services à la clientèle et Opérations.

    • Faire le suivi de l’avancement des demandes et assurer leur réalisation en temps opportun.

    • Coordonner les traductions en anglais et en français des communications et de la documentation destinées aux clients, au besoin.

    • Fournir un soutien administratif et de coordination aux initiatives de vente, au besoin.

      • Expérience client et succès client :

      • Coordonner les activités d’intégration et de désactivation des clients.

      • Aider à l’administration des comptes clients et à la gestion des utilisateurs.

      • Recueillir les commentaires des clients et communiquer les renseignements pertinents aux équipes Produits et Succès client.

      • Acheminer les enjeux clients aux équipes internes appropriées et faire le suivi de leur résolution.

      • Assurer un soutien de relève pour les demandes entrantes des clients.

        • Soutien aux opérationsinternes :

        • Administrer les droits d’accès des clients au moyen des systèmes internes.

        • Contribuer aux activités de déploiement de produits, y compris la documentation et les communications internes.

        • Soutenir les activités d’essais d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (EAU), au besoin.

        • Acheminer les enjeux liés aux clients aux équipes internes.

        • Coordonner les séances et le matériel de formation interne sur les produits.

        • Fournir un soutien et une formation de relève minimale au personnel de Numeris.

          • Soutien aux clients externes :

          • Offrir aux clients une formation et des conseils de base sur les produits.

          • Aider à acheminer les demandes de vente entrantes au gestionnaire de compte approprié.

          • Assurer un soutien de relève pour les activités de service à la clientèle.

          • Établir des relations positives avec les clients tout en assurant un niveau de service élevé.

          • Aider les gestionnaires de compte dans le cadre des renouvellements annuels des clients.

            • ------

            Product Communications & Documentation

          • Coordinate client-facing product communications, including release notes, service notifications, and technical announcements with the marketing team.
          • Maintain and update client-facing documentation, including support articles, user guides, dashboards, and monthly client reports.
          • Coordinate requests between Marketing, Product, Client Service, and Operations teams.
          • Track request progress and ensure timely completion
          • Coordinate English and French translations for client communications and documentation where required.
          • Provide administrative and coordination support for sales initiatives as required

            • Client Experience & Customer Success:

          • Coordinate client onboarding and offboarding activities.
          • Assist with client account administration and user management.
          • Gather client feedback and communicate insights to Product and Customer Success teams.
          • Escalate client issues to appropriate internal teams and track resolution.
          • Provide backup support for incoming client inquiries.

            • Internal Operations Support:

          • Administer client entitlements using internal systems.
          • Assist with product rollout activities, including documentation and internal communications.
          • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities when required.
          • Escalate client-related issues to internal teams
          • Coordinate internal product training sessions and materials.
          • Provide minimal backup support and training to Numeris staff.

            • External Client Support:

          • Deliver basic product training and guidance to clients.
          • Assist with routing incoming sales inquiries to the appropriate Account Manager.
          • Provide backup support for customer service activities.
          • Build positive relationships with clients while ensuring a high level of service.
          • Assist Account Managers during client annual renewals.

What you need | Ce dont vous avez besoin

  • Baccalauréat, diplôme d’études collégiales ou diplôme en marketing, en communications, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou expérience équivalente)
  • De 1 à 3 ans d’expérience dans le secteur de la publicité ou de la radiodiffusion
  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en réussite client, en coordination marketing ou dans un rôle lié aux communications techniques
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook). Aisance à apprendre de nouveaux logiciels et systèmes d’affaires.
  • Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de la relation client (CRM), comme Salesforce ou HubSpot, et des outils de soutien client comme Zendesk est considérée comme un atout.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais et en français, avec la capacité de communiquer clairement et professionnellement avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes.
  • Capacité de vulgariser de l’information technique dans des communications faciles à comprendre pour les clients.
  • Solides compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps, avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches, de coordonner plusieurs demandes et de respecter les échéances dans un environnement au rythme rapide.
  • Grande attention aux détails et à l’exactitude.
  • Souci marqué d’offrir un excellent service à la clientèle et d’établir des relations positives.
  • Fait preuve de professionnalisme, de réactivité et d’une approche axée sur le client.
  • Capacité de cerner les enjeux, de recueillir l’information pertinente et de déterminer s’il convient de résoudre la situation de façon autonome ou de l’acheminer au niveau approprié.
  • Fait preuve de jugement et d’une volonté d’apprendre.
  • Travaille efficacement avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris les Services à la clientèle, Produits, Marketing, Recherche et Opérations.
  • À l’aise de travailler de façon autonome tout en contribuant aux objectifs de l’équipe.
  • Apprend rapidement et accueille favorablement les nouveaux processus, les nouvelles technologies et les priorités d’affaires changeantes.

  • 1-3 years of experience in advertising, broadcasting industry

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook etc.)
  • Comfortable learning new software and business systems.

Text- und Videotherapie

ifeel – Internationale Plattform für psychische Gesundheit

Ifeel ist eine globale Plattform für psychische Gesundheit, die in über 90 Ländern tätig ist und für ihren evidenzbasierten, klinischen Ansatz sowie ihren Fokus auf das Wohlbefinden von Mitarbeitenden bekannt ist. Wir suchen Psychotherapeut:innen mit gültiger Approbation in Deutschland, die Teil unseres internationalen Netzwerks werden möchten, um Nutzer im Rahmen einer flexiblen, vertraulichen und qualitativ hochwertigen therapeutischen Begleitung zu unterstützen.

Als Therapeut bei ifeel haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Patient über zwei ergänzende Formate zu begleiten:

Videositzungen: 40-minütige Online-Sitzungen, die entsprechend Ihrer Verfügbarkeit und Arbeitssprache geplant werden.

Texttherapie: asynchrone schriftliche Kommunikation, die eine kontinuierliche und flexible Begleitung ermöglicht.

Sie werden Teil eines multikulturellen Netzwerks von Psycholog:innen und profitieren von evidenzbasierten klinischen Tools, einem erfahrenen Clinical Team sowie einem kontinuierlichen Zustrom an Patient in Ihrem jeweiligen Fachbereich.

Requirements

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Psychologie (Bachelor) sowie ein Masterabschluss oder eine therapeutische Weiterbildung im Bereich Psychotherapie, Beratung oder Mental Health, mit in Deutschland anerkanntem Abschluss.

- Erfahrung im Bereich psychologischer Beratung, Therapie oder psychischer Gesundheit von Vorteil.

- Kenntnisse in therapeutischen Ansätzen wie Verhaltenstherapie, systemischer Therapie, humanistischen oder integrativen Verfahren von Vorteil.

- Fähigkeit, selbstständig in einem digitalen Arbeitsumfeld zu arbeiten.

- Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

- Interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Erfahrung mit internationalen oder multikulturellen Patienten von Vorteil.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

Erfahrung im Bereich Telemedizin oder Online-Therapieplattformen.

Mehrsprachigkeit von Vorteil.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass Bewerbungen von Heilpraktiker für Psychotherapie für diese Position leider nicht berücksichtigt werden können.

Benefits

  • Die modernste E-Therapie-Plattform: Nutzen Sie fortschrittliche Online-Therapie-Tools, um Ihre Patient:innen effektiv zu begleiten.
  • Vereinfachtes Patient:innenmanagement: Konzentrieren Sie sich vollständig auf die Bedürfnisse Ihrer Patient:innen, ohne den Aufwand und die Kosten für Marketing oder den Aufbau einer eigenen Website. Wir vermitteln Ihnen Patient:innen ohne zusätzliche Kosten.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice: Genießen Sie die Freiheit, Ihre Arbeitszeiten und Ihren Arbeitsort flexibel zu gestalten.
  • Faire Vergütung pro Sitzung: Sie erhalten eine Vergütung für jede durchgeführte Sitzung und werden somit fair für Ihre wertvolle fachliche Expertise entlohnt.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Unterstützung: Profitieren Sie von regelmäßigen Schulungen und professioneller Unterstützung, um Ihre Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und Ihre berufliche Laufbahn zu fördern.
  • Globale Community: Tauschen Sie sich mit einem vielfältigen Netzwerk von Fachkräften aus der ganzen Welt aus und profitieren Sie von Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Unterstützung.
  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Leisten Sie einen echten Beitrag in einem wachsenden und dynamischen Umfeld.

Wir schätzen Ihr Interesse an ifeel sehr. ifeel ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber:innen werden unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft oder Behinderung berücksichtigt. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir aufgrund des hohen Bewerbungsaufkommens ausschließlich vorausgewählte Bewerber:innen kontaktieren werden.

Die von Ihnen mit uns geteilten Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt und ausschließlich für Zwecke der Bewertung und Auswahl verwendet. Ihr Lebenslauf sowie alle weiteren eingereichten Unterlagen werden gemäß den geltenden Datenschutzbestimmungen während des Bewerbungsprozesses gespeichert und spätestens zwei (2) Jahre nach Abschluss des Auswahlverfahrens gelöscht, sofern keine anderweitige Vereinbarung getroffen wurde. Mit Ihrer Bewerbung erklären Sie sich mit der Verarbeitung Ihrer Daten im Rahmen dieses Bewerbungsprozesses einverstanden.

Strongpoint Partners combines a relentless passion for service and innovation with the experience and expertise required to make retirement work for everyone. For more information, please visit: .

Onboarding Document Specialist

At Strongpoint Partners, we’re making retirement work for everyone. As a national network of retirement and payroll businesses, we bring together deep industry expertise, technology, and a shared commitment to delivering an exceptional experience for our clients and partners.

We’re looking for an Onboarding Document Specialist to join our team and help ensure a seamless experience for new retirement plan clients. In this role, you’ll support the onboarding of retirement plans with a focus on plan documentation, accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.

You’ll work closely with advisors, plan sponsors, and teams across Strongpoint to keep onboarding moving forward and make sure every detail is handled the right way.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, review, and coordinate retirement plan documents, including adoption agreements, plan documents, trust agreements, and related materials

  • Manage onboarding workflows from initial document preparation through execution and completion

  • Review documents for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with applicable IRS, ERISA, and internal requirements

  • Partner with advisors, clients, and internal teams to gather information, clarify requirements, and keep onboarding timelines on track

  • Perform detailed quality checks and identify discrepancies or missing information before documents are finalized

  • Maintain accurate digital records and documentation tracking throughout the onboarding process

  • Enter, update, and maintain plan and client information across internal systems

  • Help identify opportunities to improve onboarding processes, workflows, and overall efficiency

  • Stay informed on regulatory and industry changes that may impact retirement plan documentation

  • Collaborate across teams and partner organizations to help deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in retirement plans, TPA operations, financial services, or a related field

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and workflows

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to take ownership of work from start to finish

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with 401(k), qualified retirement plans, or 3(16) services

  • Familiarity with IRS and ERISA requirements related to retirement plan documentation

  • Experience with TPA or retirement plan administration systems such as FT William, Relius, ASC, or PensionPro

  • ASPPA credentials such as QKA or QKC, or demonstrated progress toward certification

  • Experience supporting plan onboarding, document preparation, or implementation

Our Value-Driven Employee Experience:
